items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: There's a guy named Melvin Sparks, very good we played together up near Boston.

ctx.x: When did you first meet him?

George? he used to come hear me play at a place called the Burn on 155th or 34th somewhere around there, and Lenox Avenue. And then I used to go and hear him when I first heard him around Minton's. That's when Minton's was on its last legs. And I said, damn, this cat sure can play. And I wasn't playin' at the time, I lost interest. He actually started me to go back, I said, hell I better get goin', you know. I said, I never could play that fast, but I got myself back in shape. He's the cause, he instigated. I…
What are your thoughts about jazz music has changed over the years.
